trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. There is no shortcut: the road runs through the story, the stranger strands, the activities, the collectibles and the 100% checklist. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist has 35 lines and opens in the Progress menu only after you finish the story. PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion: you need any 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned and 100 of the 255 animals studied, plus the story, task, exploration and activity lines. Most of it is finished by doing the other trophies; save this for last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps and unique stunts across Leonida all count; your count is in Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Work them into free-roam driving instead of grinding them in one sitting — ramps, jumps and air time add up fast.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game tracks 9 activity types (Touchpad > Progress > Activities): play one round of each — a race, a fishing spot, the shooting range, an arcade game, a drone race and the rest — and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 gold medals across the ranges. Use a steady weapon, take your time on the timed lanes and retry any challenge freely; ranges never lock you out.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. THE one missable trophy, flagged by both PowerPyx and GTABase: the first meditation spot, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, disappears after that chapter — and there is no mission replay. Meditate there before you finish Chapter 1. The other spots stay available, so sweep them up in free-roam afterwards.

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until he sends you after the unique animal, then take the shot he asks for. The hunt is part of his missions, so it comes to you — just don't leave his strand unfinished.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game camera: photograph 100 different spots the game recognises. Snap anything that looks like a landmark as you travel — the counter climbs in the background.

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the cops to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. Alleys, tunnels and switching vehicles help.

trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner beside you and keep the wanted level alive between them — plan a short route through three nearby shops and don't stop to fight.

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of at least five, trigger Combat Focus and drop all five before it ends. A gang hideout or a wanted-level fight gives you the crowd.

trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Get to the airport, grab a plane and take off without following the airport's script — stealing a plane off the runway is the straightforward read of it. You can retry any time.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.text: Chapters 1–5 and the final mission. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the finale — there is no mission replay. Do the Chapter 1 meditation (Positive Mental Attitude) before finishing Chapter 1: it is the only missable trophy. Turn cheats off: they disable trophies and saving.

roadmap.title: Strangers & side strands
roadmap.text: Finish the stranger strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and three more for Strangers & Freaks. Strands stay open in free-roam after the story.

roadmap.title: Activities & challenges
roadmap.text: The 9 activity types, 250 stunts, shooting-range golds, drone races, 20 race wins, fishing vs Cal, the arcade, bowling, meditation spots and any 50 of the 80 challenges.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.text: Three card sets, 100 WAiNK photos, 100 vehicles discovered and every corner of Leonida explored — plus the Ocean Beach cocktail and the showroom smash.

roadmap.title: Combat & crime sprees
roadmap.text: Wanted escapes with your partner, shop and jewelry robberies, Combat Focus, the Rhino, armored trucks, 5 bank vaults and one illegal operation per gang.

roadmap.title: Money & properties
roadmap.text: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills, spend $100,000 across the shops, buy every garage and register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

roadmap.title: Secrets & cleanup
roadmap.text: The four vague trophies (Personal Best, Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There), then the 35-line 100% checklist in the Progress menu — 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied — and the platinum pops.
